name: Ethereal Neon-Bismuth Origami
description: A hyper-dimensional realm where geometric crystal shards, reminiscent of bismuth hopper crystals, continuously fold and unfold like ethereal neon origami floating in a dark expanse.

params.name: Scale
params.description: Initial spacing of the fractal folds

params.name: Bloom Strength
params.description: The intensity of the unfolding effect when the mouse is near

params.name: Iridescence Rate
params.description: How rapidly the colors cycle across the viewing angles
